lead: Whimsical cinematic film still of a desert wasteland at golden hour, rusty scrap, dusty orange light, pink glow.
notes: Mood-only mini images for MutantLoveQuest.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen MutantLoveQuest-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish MutantLoveQuest-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: glow
images.prompt: A crater glowing toxic green in the middle of a desert wasteland, rusty cars around it.

images.name: match
images.prompt: A rusty notice board covered in handwritten lonely hearts notes and a pink paper heart.

images.name: no
images.prompt: A grumpy village gate made of stacked rusty cars, a stern guard with folded arms in front.

images.name: arena
images.prompt: A small dusty fighting ring built from scrap metal and tires in a junkyard.

images.name: road
images.prompt: A broken highway winding through a desert between two distant scrap villages.

images.name: photo
images.prompt: An old instant photo of a strange happy couple pinned to a corkboard among many others.

images.name: evening
images.prompt: A cozy scrap-metal shack at sunset with a lantern glowing in the window.

images.name: sockets
images.prompt: A workbench covered in mismatched puppet arms and legs made of wood, stone and cloth.

images.name: stubborn
images.prompt: A huge stubborn man in a mayor's sash standing like a boulder in a dusty street.

images.name: trash
images.prompt: A pile of scrap and trash bags in a junkyard at dusk, a patched-up puppet climbing out.
